text: The Disaster Resilience Improvement Program (DRIP) is a policy-based operation by the Asian Development Bank aimed at enhancing the Philippines' resilience to natural hazards and public health emergencies, including pandemics. With a loan of US$500 million, DRIP focuses on three reform pillars: improving policy and institutional arrangements for disaster risk management and health emergencies, enhancing the resilience of local government units and national assets, and developing disaster risk financing solutions.
